# Identity Breakthrough Engine (IBE)

> Identity Breakthrough Engine is a methodology-led AI coaching support platform for executive and business coaches. It supports client work between coaching sessions and prepares pre-session briefs for the human coach.

## Product

IBE keeps clients engaged between coaching calls with touchpoints based on the coach's own framework, questions, and concepts. The platform describes four agents: Mirror, Pattern, Challenge, and Integration. The Integration Agent prepares a concise brief for the coach before the next call.

The human coach remains accountable for the coaching relationship and client work. IBE is positioned as support between sessions, not a replacement for the coach.
